parameters.help_en: The page number to display in the paginated query. Range: 1~10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of items per page in the paginated query. Range: 1~1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying dynamic disposal processes. Format: Unix timestamp (in seconds)
parameters.help_zh: 查询的动态处置流程开始时间。格式为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying dynamic disposal processes. Format: Unix timestamp (in seconds)
parameters.help_zh: 查询的动态处置流程结束时间。格式为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Disposal action.
ztna_connect: Prohibit connection to the zero-trust intranet.
nac_connect: Prohibit connection to the office network access.
none: No disposal action
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作。
ztna_connect：禁止连接零信任内网。
nac_connect：禁止连接办公网准入。
none：无处置动作
parameters.name: disposal_action

parameters.help_en:
Recovery type.
auto: Automatic recovery.
console: Console recovery.
auth: Recovery by authentication and reporting
parameters.help_zh:
恢复类型。
auto：自动恢复。
console：控制台恢复。
auth：认证报备恢复
parameters.name: recovery_type

parameters.help_en:
Disposal status. Values:
disposal: In the disposal state.
finished: Already automatically recovered.
recovery: Recovered by authentication and reporting or console recovery
parameters.help_zh:
处置状态。取值：
disposal：处于处置状态。
finished：已经自动恢复。
recovery：认证报备恢复或控制台恢复
parameters.name: status
